content.text:
All 7 checks pass now.

What was wrong: `Loan.days_late` in loans.nex treated the due day as the first late day (`day >= due_on()`, then `+ 1`), so a book returned on time was fined, and every late book owed one day too many.

What I changed: a book is late only after its due day, `day > due_on()`, and the days late are `day - due_on()`.

How I checked: ran `nex checks.nex` before (4 of 7 failed) and after (all pass).
